param_input_item.param_description: Timer object. Use a scalar timer when requesting all properties.
Name of the property to query.

param_output_item.param_description: Scalar structure containing the timer property values.

description.p: get returns the value of a named timer property. Calling get with only a scalar timer returns a structure containing all timer properties, including read-only properties such as Running, TasksExecuted, AveragePeriod, and InstantPeriod.

example_item.example_item_description: Query one property and then all properties.
Read the number of completed tasks after a repeated timer finishes.
